title: Plan-and-Execute with Replanning
hints: Write one helper that builds the planner payload from (goal, completed, failed) and json.dumps it with sort_keys=True. The first call and every replan use it.
Keep `results` (id -> result) and `completed` (an ordered list). Skip any step whose id is already in results, even if the new plan lists it again.
Resolve {"$ref": id} arguments before calling the tool. A missing reference is a failed step that never touches the tool.
A replan replaces everything from the failed step onward. Check the replan budget before calling the planner, not after.
